input.task: What flux reading does the meter panel report?

provenance: PR #70 R3. `click_at`'s membership in `verifier.STATE_CHANGING` was pinned by NOTHING: delete the string and the whole suite still ran green, because every other click_at case authors an expected_state and so is verified either way. `press` and `go_back` were widened into that set by M42 with `postcondition-unverified-click` as the shape to copy, and click_at shipped without the copy. This is that case for click_at, on the same fixture and the same coordinates as `loop-click-at-resolves-and-records-coordinates`, differing from it in exactly one way: no authored `expected_state`. The run is otherwise a SUCCESS — the click lands on the bare <div>, the readout paints 7.41, the extract grounds and the answer is right — and it is failed anyway, because an unverified state change is not a verified one. Watched red on 2026-08-28 with `"click_at"` deleted from `verifier.STATE_CHANGING`: the run came back `status: success` against this case's `failure:semantic`. docs/evals/m43-red-first-ledger.md records the output.

triage.note: a state-changing verb that no case forces through the unverified-state-change guard is only in STATE_CHANGING by assertion; fix = the guard's own case, one per verb.
